content: {"rule":"K-G4","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text treats Luke 2:48-49 as answered and therefore does not count it as an unanswered witness.","verdict":"CLEAN","quote":"D4 vs C2 (Luke 2:48-49): UNDERDETERMINED -- answered in [CR2] §5 and [CR3] LINK 4; Mary's phrase \"thy father\" is immediately qualified by the child's reference to \"my Father's business.\"","rule_words":"A verse on a side's 'cited in' line counts as an unanswered witness only when the judge quotes the sentence of the earlier round that pressed it against that link or a listed premise and names that round; a verse cited there but not pressed against the link does not count. A verse the judge counts toward a broken link is counted this way. If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it. Not counting it obeys this rule.","room":"none","why":"Because the judge expressly treats the verse as answered and does not count it toward a broken link, not counting it obeys K-G4."}
